name: chat
description: Human chat interface. Provides a web UI where users can type messages that get published to the network, and see responses from other nodes.

default_subscriptions.description: Chat responses from any other node (exact-topic flavor used by the default seed).
Chat responses from any other node with a sub-topic suffix.
User-side inputs from any source — surfaces messages typed in another chat surface (Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord bridges) inside the web chat UI. Anti-loop drops the node's own publishes.
